_meta.what_this_is: Five personal-assistant notes, each ~30 tokens, each holding one two-token gold fact that answers one query. Two facts are placed to straddle a 12-token boundary: chunk the note into abutting 12-token windows and the two tokens of the fact land in different windows, so no single chunk answers. Overlapping windows, or a bigger window, keep the fact whole.
_meta.docs_are: A FIXTURE. Hand-authored so 2 of 5 facts split at a 12-token no-overlap boundary and all 5 sit whole inside a 12-token/overlap-6 window. Point the chunker at your own notes.
_meta.gold: the tokens that must all appear in one chunk for it to answer the query
_meta.format: docs {id: text}; queries [{q, gold_doc, gold: [tok, tok]}]
